sloka: सुपर्णनागयक्षाणां दैत्यदानवरक्षसाम् ।अवध्यो ऽहं प्रजाध्यक्ष देवतानां च शाश्वत ।। ७.१०.१९ ॥
transliteration: suparṇanāgayakṣāṇāṁ daityadānavarakṣasām ।avadhyo 'haṁ prajādhyakṣa devatānāṁ ca śāśvata ।। 7.10.19 ॥

translations.english: Ravana declares to Brahma that he is invulnerable to Suparnas, Nagas, Yakshas, Daityas, Danavas, Rakshasas, and gods.
